draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out Insurance, Telecom and Utilities domains (macro-F1: 85.7 vs 81.2, 83.9 vs 80.4, 86.2 vs 82.0).
rationale: T1.r3-r5 show Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7/81.2, 83.9/80.4, 86.2/82.0). The sentence's "may extend" is weaker than the evidence, which shows the advantage does hold on these three domains. No statistical test reported, so scope to these domains.
